name: analyzing-loss-reserves
description: Evaluates property and casualty loss and LAE reserves in drafts for review by a credentialed actuary: paid and reported loss development triangles by accident year, age-to-age and tail factor selection, chain ladder, Bornhuetter-Ferguson and Cape Cod with an independent expected loss ratio, IBNR, case reserve strengthening and settlement changes (Berquist-Sherman), paid versus incurred reconciliation, loss trend and social inflation, DCC and AO, salvage and subrogation, reinsurance recoverable collectibility, statutory discounting under SSAP No. 55 and SSAP No. 65, Schedule P reconciliation, carried reserve against a range of reasonable estimates, prior-year development and the adequacy side of reserve releases, ASC 944 claims development disclosures, and workpapers for an Appointed Actuary's Statement of Actuarial Opinion and AOS under ASOP Nos. 36 and 43. Use for loss reserve review, reserve adequacy or reserve study review. Never issues an opinion or selects reserves to hit a target.
